findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] alternative-mitigation-accepted: lines 180-187 register CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=settings.ALLOWED_ORIGINS - an explicit, per-environment comma-separated env list whose comprehension in config.py:163-169 discards any '*' entry, so the forbidden wildcard-plus-credentials combination cannot be reached even by operator misconfiguration. allow_credentials=True is paired with an explicit allow_methods=['GET','POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE'] and allow_headers=['Authorization','Content-Type'], satisfying the CORS spec requirement that all three be enumerated when credentials are allowed; max_age=600. No allow_origin_regex is used, so there is no unanchored-pattern subdomain risk. expose_headers is left unset, which is the restrictive default (nothing beyond the CORS-safelisted response headers is readable cross-origin). Preflight placement is sound: CsrfMiddleware (registered outside CORS) lists OPTIONS in SAFE_METHODS and AccessAuditMiddleware never short-circuits, so no auth or rate-limit layer can intercept an OPTIONS preflight before CORS answers it. | verdict=pass confidence=high
